mapper.sql:
FROM
t
JOIN ${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(detail.schema)}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(detail.table)} g ON g.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(detail.parentColumn)} = t.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(base.keyColumn)}
AND g.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote('deleted')}::text IN ('0','false')
LEFT JOIN ${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.schema)}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.table)} r${_joinIndex} ON r${_joinIndex}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.key)}::text = ${_join.sourceAlias}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.sourceColumn)}::text
AND r${_joinIndex}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote('deleted')}::text IN ('0','false')
AND (${predicates['access_r' + _joinIndex].sqlSegment})
AND r${_joinIndex}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote('creator')}::text = #{joins[${_joinIndex}].creator}
AND (${_join.sourceAlias}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.sourceColumn)} IS NULL OR r${_joinIndex}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.key)} IS NOT NULL)
AND ${_filter.alias}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_filter.column)} IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ( jsonb_populate_record(NULL::${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_filter.schema)}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_filter.table)}, CAST(#{filters[${_filterIndex}].payload} AS jsonb)) ).${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_filter.column)}
AND
>= CAST(#{dateFrom} AS date)
AND
< CAST(#{dateToExclusive} AS date)
AND IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{path[${_pathIndex}]} AS text)
AND strpos(lower(${_textFilter.field.alias}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_textFilter.field.column)}::text), lower(#{textFilters[${_textIndex}].value})) > 0
AND (${predicates[_predicateKey].sqlSegment})

FROM
t
JOIN ${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_source.statement.detail.schema)}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_source.statement.detail.table)} g ON g.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_source.statement.detail.parentColumn)} = t.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_source.statement.base.keyColumn)}
AND g.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote('deleted')}::text IN ('0','false')
LEFT JOIN ${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.schema)}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.table)} r${_joinIndex} ON r${_joinIndex}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.key)}::text = ${_join.sourceAlias}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.sourceColumn)}::text
AND r${_joinIndex}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote('deleted')}::text IN ('0','false')
AND (${_source.statement.predicates['access_r' + _joinIndex].sqlSegment.replace('#{', '#{sources[' + _sourceIndex + '].statement.')})
AND r${_joinIndex}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote('creator')}::text = #{sources[${_sourceIndex}].statement.joins[${_joinIndex}].creator}
AND (${_join.sourceAlias}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.sourceColumn)} IS NULL OR r${_joinIndex}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_join.key)} IS NOT NULL)
AND ${_filter.alias}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_filter.column)} IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ( jsonb_populate_record(NULL::${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_filter.schema)}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_filter.table)}, CAST(#{sources[${_sourceIndex}].statement.filters[${_filterIndex}].payload} AS jsonb)) ).${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_filter.column)}
AND
>= CAST(#{sources[${_sourceIndex}].statement.dateFrom} AS date)
AND
< CAST(#{sources[${_sourceIndex}].statement.dateToExclusive} AS date)
AND IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{sources[${_sourceIndex}].statement.path[${_pathIndex}]} AS text)
AND strpos(lower(${_textFilter.field.alias}.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(_textFilter.field.column)}::text), lower(#{sources[${_sourceIndex}].statement.textFilters[${_textIndex}].value})) > 0
AND (${_source.statement.predicates[_predicateKey].sqlSegment.replace('#{', '#{sources[' + _sourceIndex + '].statement.')})

foreach.if:
AND
IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{group[${_dimensionIndex}]} AS text)

AND
IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{columnGroup[${_dimensionIndex}]} AS text)

choose.when: CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE src = ${_token.source}) > 0 THEN
AS n${_partial.index}, SUM(v${_partial.index}) FILTER (WHERE p${_partial.index}) AS s${_partial.index},

if.test: ordering == null and !dimensions.isEmpty() and sortIndex != null

choose.when: LEAST(#{groupLimit}, GREATEST(${@com.richuang.os.nocode.api.ApplicationReports@MAX_CHART_GROUPS}, #{cellBudget} / GREATEST(1, (SELECT count(*) FROM colleaf c WHERE c.rn <= #{columnLimit}))))
